candidate_relations.rationale: The common mutation substrate's independent apply-time validation strengthens the pre-approval contract requirement that approval never waives later validation.
The shared mutation substrate's apply-time proposal, basis, state, and domain validation strengthens the runtime proposition that proposal and approval artifacts are revalidated before transitions.
Authority-grant tests covering scope, stale state, workflow mismatch, and materiality strengthen the grant runtime's apply-time validation proposition.
The exact-copy manifest's matching source and destination blob identities strengthen the copied-artifacts proposition requiring parity copies to remain byte-identical.
The Frozen Extraction Copy workflow's source verification and exact artifact copying strengthen the copied-artifacts parity proposition.

Persisting the exact verified manifest while keeping operational metadata outside content identity strengthens the contract's separation of semantic package identity from transport and event metadata.
Rupi update/recovery tests exercising bounded recovery intent and replanning strengthen the proposition that interrupted-install recovery is exposed as a bounded primitive.
Installer recovery tests covering durable interrupted transactions and fail-closed malformed state strengthen the bounded install-recovery adapter proposition.
Recovery tests that restore or finalize by journal phase and are idempotent strengthen the installer proposition that a durable project-local journal drives interrupted-operation recovery.
The human-agent runtime's separate protected-ceremony and control-operation adapters strengthen the tests' proposition that these remain explicit adapter boundaries across sessions.
Steward authorization validation of role state remains applicable only with a valid role-registry state and projection supplied by the role runtime.
Keeping protected authority setup outside the install/bootstrap Rupi lifecycle strengthens the operator-registry contract's rule that installation and bootstrap create no operator authority.
Rupi tests showing no surfaced authority setup and no false success strengthen the rule that installation/bootstrap do not create operator authority.
Human-Agent tests that preserve protected ceremonies as explicit adapter boundaries strengthen the protected-confirmation primitive's separation from authority effects.
Rupi conformance evidence that it has no reconciliation, admission, or Canon-mutation path strengthens the architecture separation between semantic reconciliation and separately authorized admission.
Production-invocation tests leaving canonical bytes unchanged strengthen the architecture proposition that candidate production/reconciliation are separate from canonical admission mutation.
The admission pressure test's exact-base guarded reused-record updates strengthen the preserved reference transaction's guarded-update mechanics.
Rupi update tests that stop mutation on managed drift strengthen the installer-runner contract's fail-closed managed-drift requirement.

The package plan's explicit rule that installing a Steward role grants no Steward authority strengthens the Rupi handoff decision to keep protected authority setup outside install/bootstrap lifecycle.
